# OMP Integration

OMP (Oh My Pi) consumes the root Agent Plugins v1 manifest and shared skills. No OMP-specific manifest applies: OMP parses the standard `plugin.json` and validates skill frontmatter natively, so this package ships no host manifest shim. Install the staged package through the host plugin flow (`maestria install omp` stages `@maestria/plugin` via `omp plugin install`), then load the `global-rules` and `orchestrator` skills in session. If the retired `@maestria/omp` native package is still installed, remove it first (`omp plugin uninstall @maestria/omp`) so its executable hooks do not shadow the portable skills.

## Specialist → task() Routing

Dispatch each persona through OMP's native `task(agent, task)` tool. Load the persona skill first so its methodology is in context, then delegate one coherent outcome per call.

| Persona | Native dispatch | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| adventurer | `task(agent: "adventurer", task: "...")` | Before implementation in unfamiliar code |
| architect | `task(agent: "architect", task: "...")` | When multiple approaches exist |
| builder | `task(agent: "builder", task: "...")` | When the design is locked |
| diagnose | `task(agent: "diagnose", task: "...")` | When something is broken |
| planner | `task(agent: "planner", task: "...")` | Before multi-step work |
| reviewer | `task(agent: "reviewer", task: "...")` | After the integrated batch is reconciled |
| writer | `task(agent: "writer", task: "...")` | When code needs human-facing docs |

## Session-Start Behavior

No maestria code runs at session start. The retired native package deployed agent files to `~/.omp/agent/agents/`, injected mode prompts on `before_agent_start`, preserved session state across compaction, mirrored OMP goal state, and intercepted tool calls; none of that ships here. Load `global-rules` once per session and the `orchestrator` skill to route work; keep exploration, planning, and review read-only and retain independent maker/checker roles. Invoke the fein, sonar, and blitz workflow modes as skills, not slash commands: the retired `/fein`, `/sonar`, `/blitz`, `/review`, `/restore-model`, `/review-model`, `/handoff`, and `/maestria-status` commands are gone, and per-agent model frontmatter (`maestria configure omp`) no longer applies.

The shared portable skills define methodology; the host owns tools, delegation, permissions, and lifecycle. This bundle includes no executable extension, no `maestria_subagent` wrapper tool, no review-mode enforcement, and no MCP declaration.

See [Oh My Pi](https://omp.sh/).

Live host loading is unverified. Package and sync checks validate the shipped files, not runtime discovery or enforcement.
